rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Our Deluxe Room is designed for comfort and relaxation. It features a soft queen-size bed with fresh linens, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi and a TV for your entertainment. The private bathroom includes hot and cold showers plus complimentary bathroom essentials. Large windows fill the room with natural light and offer a beautiful view of the city or surroundings. Step out onto your private balcony to enjoy fresh air and scenic views. A study table is provided for guests who wish to work or read during their stay. For your convenience and security, the room is equipped with a modern card lock entry system. Suitable for up to two guests, it’s a perfect choice for couples or friends looking for a peaceful and comfortable stay at our Arati Hotel. Size: 230 sq. ft. approx.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Our Standard Room offers a cozy and budget-friendly stay for up to two guests. It features a comfortable bed with fresh linens, free Wi-Fi a TV and a study table. The private bathroom includes hot and cold showers plus complimentary bathroom essentials. Large windows let in natural light and offer a pleasant view of the city or surroundings. Step out onto your private balcony to enjoy fresh air and relaxing views. A great choice for couples or friends looking for a simple and comfortable stay at Arati Hotel.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Our Family Room offers a spacious and comfortable stay for families. It features multiple beds with fresh linens a cozy seating area and a study table for work or play. Stay connected with free Wi-Fi and enjoy entertainment on the flat-screen TV. The private bathroom includes hot and cold showers and complimentary bathroom essentials. Large windows bring in natural light and offer pleasant views of the city or surroundings. Ideal for families looking for a simple and cozy stay at Arati Hotel. Size: 320 sq. ft. approx.

rooms.name: Suite Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Experience luxury and space in our Suite Deluxe Room, perfect for guests who want extra comfort. This elegant room features a soft queen-size bed with fresh linens, a separate living area with a comfortable sofa and a study table for work or relaxation. Enjoy modern amenities like air conditioning, free Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV. The private bathroom includes hot and cold showers and complimentary bathroom essentials. Large windows fill the suite with natural light and offer beautiful views of the city or surroundings. For your convenience and security, the room is equipped with a modern card lock system. Ideal for couples, small families or business travelers seeking a stylish and spacious stay at Arati Hotel. Size: 600 sq. ft. approx.

rooms.name: Suite Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Enjoy a spacious suite with a comfy queen-size bed, separate living area with sofa, study table, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi and a private bathroom with hot/cold shower. Beautiful city views and secure card lock system complete your perfect stay at Arati Hotel. Size: 600 sq. ft. approx.

rooms.name: Super Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Experience refined comfort and elegance in our Super Deluxe Room, the perfect choice for travelers seeking a step above luxury. This spacious room boasts a plush queen-size bed with premium linens, a cozy seating area to unwind and a dedicated study table for work or leisure. Stay connected with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi and enjoy entertainment on the flat-screen TV. The private bathroom features modern fixtures, hot and cold showers, and complimentary bathroom essentials for your convenience. Large windows bathe the room in natural light and offer stunning views of the city. Step out onto your private balcony to enjoy fresh air and scenic surroundings. Enhanced with a secure card lock system, the Super Deluxe Room at Arati Hotel combines style, security and comfort for an unforgettable stay. Size: 300 sq. ft. approx.
